laws.name: Delaware Family and Medical Leave (FMLA – Federal)
laws.description: Delaware employees are covered by the federal FMLA, which provides up to 12 weeks of job‑protected unpaid leave for qualifying medical and family reasons.

laws.name: Delaware Pregnant Workers Fairness Act
laws.description: Requires employers to provide reasonable accommodations for pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions. Includes job protection against discrimination or retaliation.

laws.name: Delaware Domestic Violence Leave
laws.description: Employees may take leave to address domestic violence issues, including seeking medical care, counseling, legal assistance, or relocation. Employers may not retaliate against employees for taking this leave.
